name: Sonaselection India Limited

components.basis: summary form read; 613-page prospectus read; no contradictions

not_assessed.why: no usable price comparison in the prospectus
no profit and revenue pair on file
fresh issue and total size not both readable
need at least two readings to see a rate

flags.detail: 106.71% a year — scored just below the band beneath it, because a pre-IPO surge is as often a reason for the timing as a sign of quality
flags.for_ai: check whether the growth is organic and repeatable

flags.flag: revenue more than tripled in two years
flags.for_ai: veto check — is this explained in the RHP?

flags.flag: the business consumed cash in its latest year
flags.detail: operating cash flow -109.89 against a reported profit
flags.for_ai: where did the money go — receivables, inventory, or both?
what are the repayment terms, and do the issue proceeds repay any of it?

triggered.veto: revenue more than tripled in two years without explanation
triggered.note: stands until the AI stage finds an explanation in the RHP

not_tested: three years of profit not on file
qualified or adverse audit opinion — needs the prospectus chapters read
SEBI or criminal proceedings against the promoters — needs the prospectus chapters read
more than half of revenue from one related party — needs the prospectus chapters read

status: quant only — the AI block has not been built, so these are not final verdicts
